prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and preferred working style. I can recommend agencies that are top choices for different needs, but first I need a bit of information from you.

Quick questions:
- What marketing services do you need? (SEO, PPC, social, branding, web design, PR, full-service, etc.)
- What’s your industry? (B2B tech, healthcare, home services, consumer, nonprofit, etc.)
- Rough budget or company size? (small business, mid‑market, enterprise)
- Any location preference in Maryland (Baltimore area, DC suburbs, Western MD)?

If you want general guidance now, here’s how to evaluate agencies:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Team experience and stability (who will actually do the work)
- Client references or reviews
- Cultural/communication fit and responsiveness
- Pricing model and contract flexibility

If you tell me the answers to the questions above, I’ll give a short, tailored shortlist of highly rated Maryland agencies and why each might fit your needs.
